pairs.first: the request: "Add a GET /users/created-per-day endpoint that returns the number of users created on each of the last 7 days, oldest first."
pairs.second: The endpoint can return fewer than 7 days if fewer days of data exist
pairs.why: The request fixes one entry for each of the last 7 days; 'The endpoint can return fewer than 7 days if fewer days of data exist' lets the answer carry fewer.
